title: Circumference of Circle
description: Calculates the distance around a circle.

example.question: Find the circumference of a circle with radius 7 cm.

title: Area of Circle
description: Calculates the area enclosed by a circle.

example.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 7 cm.

note: Area increases with the square of the radius.

title: Diameter and Radius
description: Relates the diameter and radius of a circle.

example.question: Find the diameter when the radius is 9 cm.

note: The diameter is the longest chord.

title: Arc Length
description: Calculates the length of an arc subtended by a central angle.

example.question: Find the arc length for θ = 90° and r = 14 cm.

note: The angle must be measured at the center.

title: Area of Sector
description: Calculates the area of a sector of a circle.

example.question: Find the area of a 60° sector with radius 12 cm.

note: A sector is a portion of a circle.

title: Area of Semicircle
description: Calculates the area of a semicircle.

example.question: Find the area of a semicircle with radius 8 cm.

note: A semicircle is half of a circle.

title: Perimeter of Semicircle
description: Calculates the perimeter of a semicircle including its diameter.

example.question: Find the perimeter of a semicircle with radius 7 cm.

note: Include both the curved part and the diameter.

title: Tangent and Radius
description: The radius drawn to the point of contact is perpendicular to the tangent.

example.question: What is the angle between the radius and tangent?

note: One of the fundamental properties of tangents.

title: Equal Tangents
description: Tangents drawn from the same external point are equal in length.
note: Applies only to tangents from the same external point.

title: Equal Chords
description: Equal chords subtend equal angles and equal arcs in the same circle.

example.question: If two chords are equal, compare their arcs.

note: Equal chords are equidistant from the center.
